title: ImageUpload
description: POST /api/v1/jois/{id}/images (since 1.11): an image the server took, to be sent with a message in `ChatRequest.images` or `Say.images`.

mimeType.description: What the server keeps it as (image/jpeg): a large image is scaled down to 1568 pixels on its longest side and written as JPEG, which is also what the model gets.

size.description: Its size in bytes, as kept.

width.description: Its width in pixels, as kept.

height.description: Its height in pixels, as kept.
